PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Secondary school physics teacher with ten years of classroom experience and
a record of consistently strong board results. Designs hands-on lab work,
mentors science club students for state exhibitions, and coordinates the
school's annual academic calendar. Seeking a head-of-department role.

SKILLS
- Teaching: lesson planning, differentiated instruction, formative assessment
- Laboratory: practical demonstrations, lab safety, equipment upkeep
- Mentoring: science club, olympiad coaching, exhibition projects
- Administration: timetabling, invigilation rosters, parent communication
- Curriculum: board syllabus mapping, question paper setting, moderation

EXPERIENCE

June 2018 to April 2025
- Taught physics to classes IX through XII, average batch of 160 students.
- Raised the class XII physics board average from 71% to 84% in four years.
- Built a low-cost demonstration kit programme replicated by two sister

- Coordinated the school science exhibition; three student teams reached

- Served as exam cell coordinator for board examinations.

June 2014 to May 2018
- Taught classes VIII through X and ran the after-school science club.
- Introduced weekly lab journals that improved practical exam scores.
